COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_occupation = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_occupation_tt
		hidden_trigger = {
			OR = {
				511 = {
					is_controlled_by = VIE
					NOT = { is_core_of = VIE }
				}
				512 = {
					is_controlled_by = VIE
					NOT = { is_core_of = VIE }
				}
				513 = {
					is_controlled_by = VIE
					NOT = { is_core_of = VIE }
				}
				514 = {
					is_controlled_by = VIE
					NOT = { is_core_of = VIE }
				}
			}
		}
	}
}
COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_native_assistance = {
	custom_trigger_tooltip = {
		tooltip = COLDWAR_VIE_campaign_cbd_native_assistance_tt
		hidden_trigger = {
			VIE = {
				exists = yes
				NOT = { has_war_with = CBD }
				OR = {
					AND = {
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_state@CBD = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_size@CBD > 0 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p6_end@CBD > global.num_days }
					}
					AND = {
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_state@CBD = 1 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_size@CBD > 0 }
						check_variable = { mdcw_cw_p7_end@CBD > global.num_days }
					}
				}
			}
		}
	}
}

		hidden_trigger = {

				CBD = { is_subject_of = VIE }

			}
		}
	}
